reading.title: Policy Analysis and Fiscal Impact Statement CR-073-2024 FY 2024 PILOT New Carrolton – Affordable – Phase 3 – 9% Project

candidates.quote: Description: A fifty (50) unit affordable family rental apartment community that will be constructed in New Carrollton, Maryland.
All units will be affordable, and rents will be restricted for forty (40) years.

Under the proposed agreement, for at least a 40-year term, Urban Atlantic Development LLC (the “Developer”) will construct six (50) units for families whose incomes are at or below 50% of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
